name: stitch
title: Stitch
description: Stitch is a cloud ETL service that integrates various data sources into a central data warehouse through various integrations.
label: cloud,api,saas,bigdata

properties.name: tableName
properties.description: The name of the destination table the data is being pushed to. Table names must be unique in each destination schema, or loading issues will occur. Note: The number of characters in the table name should be within the destination's allowed limits or data will rejected.

properties.name: keyNames
properties.label: producer
properties.description: A collection of comma separated strings representing the Primary Key fields in the source table. Stitch use these Primary Keys to de-dupe data during loading If not provided, the table will be loaded in an append-only manner.

properties.name: stitchSchema
properties.label: producer
properties.description: A schema that describes the record(s)

properties.name: connectionProvider
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: ConnectionProvider contain configuration for the HttpClient like Maximum connection limit .. etc, you can inject this ConnectionProvider and the StitchClient will initialize HttpClient with this ConnectionProvider

properties.name: httpClient
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Reactor Netty HttpClient, you can injected it if you want to have custom HttpClient

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: stitchClient
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: Set a custom StitchClient that implements org.apache.camel.component.stitch.client.StitchClient interface

properties.name: token
properties.label: security
properties.description: Stitch access token for the Stitch Import API
